statement: A constrained RMSNorm inversion makes the bfloat16 patch more stable, with token agreement rising from 87.5% to 98% in the judged source rendering (100% in arXiv v3).

protocol.stable_update: Appendix-B constrained RMSNorm inversion, rank-1 down-projection patch, and scale-vector remainder

verdict_rule.VERIFIED_JUDGED_RENDERING: All gates pass and stable bfloat16 agreement is exactly 0.98.
verdict_rule.VERIFIED_ARXIV_V3: All gates pass and stable bfloat16 agreement is exactly 1.0.
verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: All gates pass and stable bfloat16 agreement is neither 0.98 nor 1.0, or it does not improve over naive bfloat16.
verdict_rule.BLOCKED: Any fidelity or evidence-integrity gate fails.
